item.title: DOJ launches civil rights investigation in Alex Pretti's death
item.description: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche confirms the Department of Justice has opened a civil rights investigation into the shooting death of Alex Pretti by Bordr Patrol in Minneapolis.

item.title: Vikings fire GM Kwesi Adofo-Mensah after 4 seasons

item.title: Lake Bde Maka Ska gathering creates 'SOS' message made from people
item.description: In a powerful display of unity, Minnesotans gathered on the icy surface of Bde Maka Ska, forming the letters "SOS" to convey a message of support for the state's immigrants during tense times.Community gathers for a message of supportMore than a thousand people, walking or skating in boots, joined together to form the letters "SOS" on the ice.
